ideas.pitch: Satellite-based agricultural compliance and water usage monitoring platform tailored for West Texas farming operations.
ideas.title: WestTexas-AgriMonitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS by combining geospatial data with industrial monitoring, which appeals heavily to judges in the agricultural region of Lubbock.

ideas.pitch: Autonomous grain marketplace with automated USDC escrow payments and regional logistics coordination on Base.
ideas.title: SorghumChain Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact architecture and win condition of the Dispatch autonomous marketplace project by combining decentralized escrow with local supply chain use cases.

ideas.pitch: AWS-powered risk detection platform combining graph intelligence and lightGBM to flag fraudulent livestock auction transactions.
ideas.title: RanchRisk AML Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven architecture of Bito to deliver hard engineering via graph intelligence and financial crime detection adapted for regional commerce.

ideas.pitch: Personalized meal and nutrition planning assistant tailored specifically to regional dietary restrictions and local Texas food supplies.
ideas.title: Oasis Nutrition AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies the successful formula of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant with a localized twist that makes the generated health insights immediately practical for local communities.

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent forecasting platform using Poisson regression and rolling backtests to predict local ERCOT power grid incidents and price spikes.
ideas.title: GridBackstop AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the rigorous statistical methodology of the Apart Research AI Forecasting winner, targeting a critical infrastructure topic deeply relevant to Texas participants.
